requirements.text: The permanent global Project Manager supervisor identity is exactly mc-project-manager.
Canonical Mission Control supervisor configuration rejects any configured PROJECT_MANAGER entry whose supervisorId is not mc-project-manager.
A dedicated real ChatGPT bootstrap conversation URL/chatId and capability challenge for mc-project-manager are registered and live-verified.
The PM-mediated exact owner-byte forwarding path is demonstrated live through the registered global Project Manager and a fresh supervisor decision session.

boundaries: Do not alias, rename, or promote mc-hotfix-specialist into the global Project Manager role.
Do not invent or fabricate a ChatGPT conversation locator, bootstrap chatId, capability challenge, provider receipt, or provider source timestamp.
Identity authorization does not authorize deployment, production mutation, privacy-boundary widening, spending, or publication.
The provider source timestamp requirement remains a separate blocked feature and must not be substituted with browser, GitHub, or receive time.
